input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 9 provides only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and security/service-failure (9.3) termination rights; there is no Section 9.4 and no termination-for-convenience right anywhere (Sections 6.2, 19.4 and 27.3 are all cause-based). The term is three years (8.1) and Section 2.1 expressly strips us of reduction or termination rights on a USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment. Absence of any Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory under the rule, so the clause fails even the fallback. We propose the preferred position: a new Section 9.4 allowing Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term, plus a conforming edit to Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay language does not override it. Vendor has no convenience right today, so nothing needs deleting on that side.

proposal.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; conform Section 2.1
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs three years but gives us no right to exit without cause, and Section 2.1 expressly negates our termination rights. We have added a Customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and conformed Section 2.1; if helpful we can discuss 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty or early-termination charge, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, subject to Customer's termination and reduction rights under this Agreement, including Section 9.4.
